name: Easy Seafood Yellow Rice Casserole with Shrimp, Mussels, Peas & Carrots

ingredients.name: mussels in garlic butter sauce, frozen
raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Transfer to a large baking dish, casserole, or braising pan, along with rice and broth, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
3 (142 g) pkg yellow rice mix
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Top rice with veggies, spreading them out in an even layer (do not stir). Cover the baking dish tightly with aluminum foil and place in the preheated oven. Bake until the rice is tender and veggies are warmed through, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the rice is done, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Carefully remove foil from the casserole, then stir to combine. Arrange shrimp over the veggies and re-cover the baking dish with foil. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the shrimp are cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, transfer mussels to a microwave safe dish, cover, and microwave on high until warmed through, 5-7 minutes. Carefully remove from the microwave. (Or follow package directions to heat mussels in the bag.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (454 g) pkg mussels in garlic butter sauce, frozen

instructions.primary_message: While the mussels are heating, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide seafood casserole between plates or bowls. Top with mussels and butter sauce, then sprinkle with parsley. Enjoy!
